## Batch 29 handoff

Authored the four A-page items and three worked examples; both pages are frontmatter-only with no summaries. The [A page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/machine-learning/ml02-private-learning.md>) and [Examples page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/machine-learning/ml02-private-learning-examples.md>) inventories match the [batch manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-29.pages.json>). Source coverage records three treatments per page, including Dwork–Roth’s private-learning and online-learning sections ([full text](https://privacytools.seas.harvard.edu/resource/thealgorithmicfoundationsofdifferentialprivacypdf)).

**Readiness:** Four items are recorded `ready`; the private ERM theorem and its two dependent examples are `escalated`. Their supplier, `thm-finite-class-agnostic-erm-bound`, has a stale readiness hash: `step1Decision` reports “Item or dependency changed; record current readiness.” I left that supplier untouched.

**Checks:** Precheck passed for 7 items; proof-layout passed with 27 steps and 0 defects; strict contracts passed 7/7; scoped dependency, render, content-policy, statement-first, coverage, and source-fetch checks passed. Source fetch verified 6/6 entries using existing stamps.

**Shared blockers:** The full dependency-level check finds 70 unrelated empty scaffold inventories, with no batch‑29 level errors. Full-run proof-contract coverage stops at the unrelated empty `distribution-shift-and-domain-adaptation` inventory. The dispatch and dependency-level artifact hashes differ, though both agree batch 29 is level 2 with prerequisites 3 and 28; this is recorded for reconciliation. All pages remain draft; these records are not independent approval or publication.
